about: The 12 contracts of NIGHT25 (the master prompt). The lead sets passes / evidence only from this night's printed lines. owner = the builder queue in NIGHT25.md (C combat, W the worm, L levels and the campaign, F feel / HUD / prompts, lead = the lead). A number in a check is a threshold the run must print; where a number is our inference (RESEARCH.md), the run tunes the config to meet it and prints both the first and the final value.

features.check: no Player boot path (TITLE > PLAY in SURVIVAL with the worm on; MODE > CAMPAIGN; -skygrindMap layer1) shows the worm over an empty sky: the arena has floor, walls and light on every path and no SURVIVAL banner ('ROUND 1 . 0 LEFT') is up during a campaign boss; one Player line per path prints what was on screen (floor present, banner text)

the worm's HUD bar shows its name, HP fraction and phase pips from the intro to the death, text 18 px or more, no pop-in (M9 0), through BossKit.BossBar and HudReads20; the result line prints the bar's fraction at 100 %, 66 %, 33 % and 0 % of the pool

on a Player the worm dies: the HP pool reaches 0, the finisher plays, bossDown fires once, and the run moves on (the next door opens or RESULTS); proven from the reel AND a human-like composed-sim run; the result line prints the time to death

spit leads the player's velocity, the lunge locks at its tell and re-aims once, the safe window shrinks 10-15 % per phase, phase 3 overlaps two compatible attacks; every tell >= 0.5 s and no two lethal attacks resolve inside 0.5 s (the harness reads the table); player hits per minute printed before and after; the composed-sim human bot kills it in 3:30-4:30; attack count unchanged (47 told)

with the row on a held fire button and the quick melee in the same frame both resolve: a harness holds both for 3 s and prints shots and punches (before: one blocks the other; after: both counts rise by their own cooldowns, each within 10 % of the alone rate); --off25 restores the serialised rules; golden exact

the THUNDERCLAP has no shockwave / LT shove (its LT zooms); a grep of Core/Guns and config finds no shotgun shockwave row in either config copy; a Player line shows LT on the shotgun zooms and no shockwave event fires; --off25 restores it; the tests that asserted the shockwave are changed and listed

the PULSE GAUNTLET's left click builds charge by its own hits (about 6-8 hits per tier, printed), never by time (idle 60 s = +0) and no longer by other guns' kills; a charged release launches along the aim 0.5 / 1.0 / 2.25 of a jump distance (measured on the Mover, printed) with a little damage (printed); 3 s lockout, one air flick, clamped on the collider; the long-cooldown rule (CORE.md) is met by the charge cost; the reel prints before and after

layer 1 is six stages (look and walk; jump and slide; wall and air; the pistol; the fist; a first fight), each Exposition / Validation / Challenge with a lesson-clear condition that opens its door, a respawn at the stage's start, no enemy in stages 1-3, ONE enemy kind (husk) in the first fight; a bot clears all six, the validate report proves no soft-lock (every pit has a recovery path), prompts 18 px or more with the pad glyph on a pad; a Player line per stage

Design/levels/CURRICULUM.md lists levels 2-10 (the new thing, the world's lesson, LIMIT flags, enemies, par, pass check); each level is one plan file + a config row + a validate report with 0 errors (every tier reachable by enemies); the bot's per-room clear rate is 60-90 % (first and final numbers printed); each level's first room is a breath; levels 2-5 pass on a Player, 6-10 headless at minimum; the number of levels that play door to door is printed

on a Development Player on a quiet machine the first PLAY after boot costs under 100 ms at its worst frame (NIGHT24: 346.1 ms), or the dominant cause is named with its before and after and the row is SHORT; Hitch24's markers name the cause

Tools/night/m9-list.py on the final reel lists the pop-ins before and after; the Buy prompt, Down menu, Markers, vignettes and prompt wheel get entrances of 0.12 s or less; the lesson prompts (UiLesson25) enter and leave without a pop-in; M9 0 on every NEW element

at the freeze: if meleeFire, pulseCharge or shockwaveOff is on by default the composed fingerprint is re-recorded ONCE in its own commit with the reason (N25OnPath true); --off25 EQUAL to the NIGHT24 baseline; --off24 / --off22 / --off21 / --off19 EQUAL to theirs
